description: Only your bodyweight. Push-up and lunge variations, a table or bar for rows and a hamstring slide. Progress by slowing the lowering and choosing harder variations.

blockTypes.superset: Two exercises back to back, no rest between.

weeks.title: Settle in
weeks.focus: Stop each set about 3 reps before failure. Learn the lifts and find your starting weights.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width. Sit back and down until your thighs are at least parallel, stand tall.

exercises.name: Pushups
exercises.instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in one line. Chest to the floor, elbows about 45° from your ribs.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.instructions: Under a sturdy bar or table. Body in a straight line, pull your chest to the bar. Feet closer to make it easier.

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: One foot planted, other leg extended. Drive up through your heel and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Push-Ups - Close Triceps Position
exercises.instructions: Hands just inside your shoulders, elbows brushing your ribs. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms down, body in one straight line. Squeeze glutes and abs. Stop when your hips sag.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Long steps, back knee just above the floor, torso tall. Push through the front heel each step.

exercises.name: Push-Ups With Feet Elevated
exercises.instructions: Feet on a chair, body in one line. Lower your chest to the floor and press up.

exercises.name: Pullups
exercises.instructions: Start from a dead hang. Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down. Lower fully.

exercises.name: Natural Glute Ham Raise
exercises.instructions: Anchor your heels, lower your body slowly as far as you can control, push off the floor to come back.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands on a counter or bench. Lower your chest to it; the lower the hands, the harder the push-up.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie flat, raise your knees to your chest and lift your hips off the floor by curling your pelvis.

exercises.name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
exercises.instructions: Long stance, drop your back knee straight down. Keep your torso upright and front heel planted.

exercises.name: Push-Up Wide
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders. Lower with control until your chest is just above the floor.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: Palms toward you, shoulder-width. Pull your chin over the bar, lower under control.

exercises.name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
exercises.instructions: Feet flat, drive your hips up until your body is straight. Hold one second at the top.

exercises.name: Bench Dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on a bench behind you, lower until your elbows reach 90°, press up. Keep your hips close.

exercises.name: Side Bridge
exercises.instructions: On your forearm, lift your hips so your body is straight. Squeeze your obliques and hold.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lower back pressed into the floor. Extend opposite arm and leg slowly, then swap.

weeks.title: Add reps
weeks.focus: Beat last week's reps on your main lifts, stopping about 2 reps short of failure.

weeks.title: Deload
weeks.focus: Cut sets by about 40% and stay about 4 reps short of failure. Recovering now makes the next block better.
